title: Useful Patterns: 为了, 对…来说, 每次…都, 怪不得 / 难怪, 还好…不然, 等…再, 不知道…好
description: In order to, for someone, every time, no wonder, luckily … otherwise, wait until … then, and not knowing what to do.

points.title: 为了 + purpose，…: in order to
points.summary: 为了 (wèile) + goal comes **first**, then the action.
points.body: - **为了**学好中文，他每天都练习.
examples: I run every day for my health.

points.title: 对 + person + 来说: for (someone)
points.summary: 对 X 来说 = from X's point of view, as far as X is concerned.
examples: For me, learning characters is the hardest part.

points.title: 每次 A 都 B: every time
examples: He brings me a present every time he comes.

points.title: 怪不得 / 难怪: no wonder
points.summary: Reason，怪不得 (guàibude) / 难怪 (nánguài) + what you now understand.
points.body:
- 他在中国住了十年，**怪不得**中文说得这么好.
- 外面下雪了。——**难怪**这么冷!

points.title: 还好 …，不然 …: luckily, otherwise
points.summary: 还好 (háihǎo) = luckily; 不然 (bùrán) = otherwise (the bad outcome that was avoided).
points.body: - **还好**我带了伞，**不然**就淋湿了.
examples: {还好|háihǎo}{我|wǒ}{带|dài}{了|le}{伞|sǎn}，{不然|bùrán}{就|jiù}{淋|lín}{湿|shī}{了|le}。
Luckily I had an umbrella — otherwise I'd have got soaked.

points.title: 等(到) A，再 / 就 B: when A, then B
points.summary: 等 (děng) + event，(subject) + 再 / 就 + verb = wait until A, then B.
points.body:
- **等**你回来，我们**再**吃饭.
- **等到**明天，你**就**知道了.
examples: We'll eat when you get back.

points.title: 不知道 + question + 好: don't know what to do
points.summary: 不知道 + 怎么办 / 说什么 / 去哪儿 + 好 = don't know what would be best.
examples: I don't know what to do.

notes: 每次 = 'every time' — it doesn't give a purpose.
因为 gives a reason, not a goal.
questions.translation: He practises every day in order to learn Chinese well.

notes: The goal follows 为了 directly.
为了 comes before the goal.
questions.translation: I run every day for my health.

notes: 为了 gives a purpose — the pattern is 对…来说.
questions.translation: For me, learning characters is the hardest part.
For beginners, this book is a bit difficult.
Every time I go to Beijing I visit friends.

notes: 都 goes before the verb phrase.
都 can't split 给 and 我.
都 comes after the 每次 part.
questions.translation: He brings me a present every time he comes.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{在|zài}{中国|Zhōngguó}{住|zhù}{了|le}{十|shí}{年|nián}，（　）{中文|Zhōngwén}{说|shuō}{得|de}{这么|zhème}{好|hǎo}。
notes: 虽然 needs 但是 — and there's no contrast.
不然 = 'otherwise' — it needs a condition before it.
questions.translation: He's lived in China for ten years — no wonder his Chinese is so good.

questions.prompt:
A：{外面|wàimiàn}{下雪|xià xuě}{了|le}。
B：（　）{这么|zhème}{冷|lěng}！
questions.translation: A: It's snowing outside. B: No wonder it's so cold!
Luckily I had an umbrella — otherwise I'd have got soaked.

notes: 怪不得 = 'no wonder' — here something was avoided.
questions.translation: Good thing you reminded me — otherwise I'd have forgotten.

notes: 到你回来 isn't the pattern.
从你回来 = 'since you came back'.
questions.translation: We'll eat when you get back.

questions.prompt: {现在|xiànzài}{先|xiān}{不|bú}{告诉|gàosu}{你|nǐ}，{等到|děngdào}{明天|míngtiān}，{你|nǐ}（　）{知道|zhīdào}{了|le}。
questions.translation: I won't tell you yet — you'll find out tomorrow.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{突然|tūrán}{哭|kū}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{知道|zhīdào}{说|shuō}{什么|shénme}（　）。
notes: 说什么对 isn't the pattern.
questions.translation: He suddenly started crying, and I didn't know what to say.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{知道|zhīdào}{怎么|zěnme}{办|bàn}{好|hǎo}。」 mean?
questions.explanation: 不知道怎么办好 = **don't know what to do**.
